description: ShardKvCodec.Encode K-path wire bytes (ported from ShardKvCodec.cs). With identity-top-rank axes and zero centre: centred=k, FWHT, project onto top kRank axes, scale=maxAbs/127, int8-quantise. CompressedK = [float32 scale LE][kRank int8]. Ground-truth derived independently from the C# algorithm. V index is codeword 0 (single nearest) so idxBytes and layout are exercised too.
